## PR title

`Fix XLSX reader returning empty cells for merged-range headers`

## PR body

```markdown
## Summary

The XLSX converter dropped header text from merged ranges. When the bug is
reproduced via `tests/fixtures/merged.xlsx`, cell A2 returns an empty string
instead of `"Header"`.

## Root cause

`xlsx_converter.py:142` reads the cell value directly without resolving the
merged-range anchor. openpyxl returns `None` for non-anchor cells in a merge,
and the existing code converted `None` → `""`.

## Fix

Resolve the merge anchor before reading. Added one helper
`_merged_anchor_for(cell)` and one call site in `_read_cell`.

## Verification

`tests/test_xlsx_converter.py::test_merged_range_header_returns_anchor_value`
covers the case and passes after the fix; failed before. Diff: 18 lines
added, 2 removed, 1 commit.
```
